Shell/Tab/BRIEFING: Briefing: the mission briefing and its weather, laid out as WDP lays them out, from BMS's printed briefing or the save's flight you opened.
Shell/Tab/DATACARD: DataCard: your flight's kneeboard card (steerpoints, times, fuel, frequencies, airfields, loadout). Upd Kneeboard puts it in the cockpit.
Shell/Tab/COORDINATION: Coordination Card: the package's flights, codewords and timing, for the second kneeboard page.
Shell/Tab/MAP: Map: your cartridge as the jet's HSD will show it, beside what the mission knows. Tap a site, track or station to put it into the cartridge.
Shell/Tab/DTC: DTC: the data cartridge BMS loads into the jet (steerpoints, targets, lines, PPTs, radios, countermeasures and more). Save to DTC writes it.
Shell/Tab/PERFORMANCE: Performance: take-off speeds and fuel, climbs, cruise and a turn calculator for your F-16, its load and the field's weather. Its take-off figures fill the DataCard.
Shell/Tab/ATTACK: Attack: the three attack planners, Pop-up, HADB and TOSS, picked on the rail beside the page. Opens on the one you used last.
Shell/Attack/POPUP: Pop-up: plans a pop-up attack on the target: where to pull up, the climb, the apex and the roll-in.
Shell/Attack/HADB: HADB: plans a high-altitude dive bomb attack on the target: roll-in, dive angle and release.
Shell/Attack/TOSS: TOSS: plans a toss (loft) attack: the pull-up point, the loft angle and the release.
Shell/Tab/ATO: ATO Targets: WDP's ATO Target List as a page. The targets your side's flights are tasked to attack in the open save, units and objectives, with each flight's TOT. For information only.
Shell/Steps: Steps: the evening from BMS to the cockpit in ten short lines, beside the page (on a phone, a sheet). The step you are on is lit, and so is its toolbar button.
Steps/Panel: The ten steps from BMS to the cockpit. The lit one is where you are; BMS steps are ticked by you, the Planner's tick themselves.
Steps/Sheet: The ten steps from BMS to the cockpit. The lit one is where you are; BMS steps are ticked by you, the Planner's tick themselves.
Steps/Weather: Weather of your own is chosen and saved in BMS before anything reads it: the Planner, PRINT and Upd Kneeboard take the weather as saved.
Steps/Step/1: In BMS. Tick it when done: BMS does not tell the app.
Steps/Step/2: In BMS: the DTC window's SAVE writes your seat's codes and comm plan to the cartridge the Planner reads; the campaign or TE save is what Open mission… opens. Tick it when done.
Steps/Step/3: In BMS: PRINT on the briefing screen. The Planner's card takes the comm ladder and BMS's weather from it. Tick it when done.
Steps/Step/4: Open mission… on the toolbar (lit when you press here). On a phone this line opens it.
Steps/Step/5: Plan on the pages you need: the tabs above. Done once there are edits to save.
Steps/Step/6: Save to DTC on the toolbar (lit when you press here) writes your plan into the cartridge BMS loads.
Steps/Step/7: In BMS: the DTC window's LOAD reads what the Planner saved, then SAVE. Without LOAD, BMS writes its own old copy over the Planner's when you FLY. Tick it when done.
Steps/Step/8: Populate from Planner on the toolbar (lit when you press here) fills the Mission section and the VR boards from this flight. On a phone this line does it.
Steps/Step/9: Upd Kneeboard on the toolbar (lit when you press here) puts your cards on the cockpit kneeboard. Where the toolbar has no room for it, this line opens it.
Steps/Step/10: In BMS: FLY. In the cockpit, the MFD's DTE page, LOAD. Tick it when done.
Steps/FullGuide: The Planner guide from its start: the same steps, each with why.
Steps/ClearTicks: Clears this mission's ticks and what was marked done, to go through the steps again.
Steps/Close: Closes the steps. The toolbar's Steps opens them again.
Shell/PagePicker: The Planner page on screen. Press to pick another page.
Shell/OpenMission: Open mission…: opens a campaign, TE or training save from Falcon BMS on the PC, then you pick your flight and seat to plan.
Shell/SaveToDtc: Save to DTC: writes your edits into your cartridge (User\Config\<callsign>.ini, and an open TE's own .ini), which BMS loads into the jet. The number counts edits not saved yet.
Shell/SaveMenu: More ways to save: Re-read DTC from BMS, or Save to DTC and populate.
Shell/SaveMenu/Reread: Reads your cartridge from BMS again. Edits you have not saved are lost (it asks first).
Shell/SaveMenu/SaveAndPopulate: Saves your cartridge, then fills the Mission section from the Planner, in one press.
Shell/Populate: Populate from Planner: sends this flight, your saved cartridge and the attack to the Mission section, so every device shows the mission as planned here.
Shell/Print: Upd Kneeboard: draws the DataCard and other pages into the cockpit kneeboard pages BMS shows in the jet. Do it before you enter the cockpit.
Shell/Guide: The Planner guide: the evening from BMS to the cockpit step by step, and a card for each page.
Shell/Options: Options, as in WDP: the Planner's Settings, and About WDP. (WDP's ATO Target List is the ATO Targets tab.)
Shell/Options/Settings: Planner settings: tooltips, reopening your last mission, the folders and files the Planner uses, and reading BMS again.
Shell/Options/Credit: Weapon Delivery Planner is Falcas's program; this Planner is a port of it.
Shell/More: More: the actions that do not fit on the toolbar here.
Shell/Fit: Back to the whole page after zooming in.
Shell/FullWindow: Full window: hides the Mission header and tabs so the page gets the whole window. Press again to bring them back.
Shell/More/OpenMission: Opens a campaign, TE or training save from Falcon BMS, then you pick your flight and seat.
Shell/More/Populate: Sends this flight, your saved cartridge and the attack to the Mission section on every device.
Shell/More/Print: Draws the DataCard and other pages into the cockpit kneeboard pages.
Shell/More/Guide: The Planner guide, step by step.
Shell/More/Settings: Planner settings: tooltips, reopening your last mission, the Planner's folders and files.
Shell/More/Reread: Reads your cartridge from BMS again (asks first if you have edits not saved).
Shell/More/SaveAndPopulate: Saves your cartridge, then fills the Mission section from the Planner.
Shell/More/FullWindow: Gives the page the whole window, or brings the Mission header back.
Shell/More/Credit: Weapon Delivery Planner is Falcas's program; this Planner is a port of it.
Shell/Identity: What you are planning: theater, file or BMS briefing, package, flight and seat, and where the steerpoints come from. Press to pick another flight, or to go back to BMS's briefing (with nothing open: the Steps).
Shell/MissionShows: What the Mission section on your devices shows now. Populate from Planner on the toolbar fills it.
Shell/Credit: WDP by Falcas: Weapon Delivery Planner is Falcas's program, and this Planner is a port of it. Options → About WDP has the credit.
Settings/BmsFolder: The Falcon BMS folder the PC reads and writes. Everything the Planner opens and saves is in it.
Settings/ChangeBms: Goes to Setup, where the Falcon BMS folder is chosen.
Settings/Build: Falcon BMS's version, as the PC reads it from the install and the registry.
Settings/Theaters: BMS's list of theaters. The Planner finds each theater's campaign, objects and kneeboard files through it.
Settings/Theater: The theater Falcon BMS is set to (in its launcher), and the save's theater when you plan a save of another one.
Settings/Data: Where the Planner's airfields, aircraft and weapons come from: BMS Companion's own data, made from this Falcon BMS version.
Settings/Twx: The weather file (.twx) the DataCard's ATIS and weather come from. Reload WX on the DataCard picks another.
Settings/Fmap: The weather map (.fmap) read with the weather file, for the weather at each field.
Settings/PlannerFolder: The Planner's own folder on the PC, User\BMS Companion Planner inside Falcon BMS: the DTC's backups, PPT lists, saved maps and DataCards go there.
Settings/DataCards: The folder on the PC where Save DataCard, Save Codewords and Save Package Timing write their files, and the Load buttons read them.
Settings/BrowseDataCards: Choose another folder for the DataCards, codewords and package timing.
Settings/DefaultDataCards: Puts the DataCards folder back to DataCards in the Planner folder (User\BMS Companion Planner). Nothing is moved or deleted.
Settings/Tooltips: Turns these tips on or off on every Planner page and window.
Settings/AutoLoad: When the Planner first opens after BMS Companion starts, it opens the save you planned last with its flight and seat picked. Press Plan this flight to plan it again.
Settings/CleanOpened: On (the default): when Open mission… or Pick a flight plans another flight, the PC takes every HSD line, PPT and Open 1/Open 2 steerpoint (STPT 81-99) out of your cartridge and the campaign's mission file. The route, the Recon targets and the weapon targets stay; a TE or a training keeps its own. LOAD the DTC in BMS afterwards.
Settings/Reload: Reads the open save's flight and your cartridge from Falcon BMS again, after BMS changed them. Asks first if you have edits not saved.
Settings/Close: Closes the settings. Every change is already kept.
Guide/Close: Closes the guide. The toolbar's Guide opens it again.
Guide/Next: The guide's next page; its name is on the button.
Guide/Contents: Switches between the list of the guide's pages and the page you are reading.
OpenMission/Search: Type part of a file name, a campaign's name, your flight's callsign or a theater to narrow the list. Every theater with a match opens.
OpenMission/Refresh: Reads the list of saves from the PC again (after you SAVE in Falcon BMS).
OpenMission/Browse: Opens a save with a file window on the PC, starting in the folder of your last save. It must be in its theater's campaign folder, where BMS keeps its files.
OpenMission/ShowStock: Also lists the TEs, trainings and campaign starts that come with Falcon BMS. Starts are shown greyed: they are never opened.
OpenMission/Sort/NEWEST: Newest first, by the later of when the file was made and when it was last changed.
OpenMission/Sort/MODIFIED: By when the file was last changed, newest first.
OpenMission/Sort/CREATED: By when the file arrived on this PC, newest first.
OpenMission/Sort/NAME: By file name, A to Z.
OpenMission/Guide: Opens the Planner guide at its page for this window (without the link: planning from another device).
OpenMission/Cancel: Closes the window without opening anything.
FlightPicker/Find: Opens the package whose number you typed and scrolls to it.
FlightPicker/ExpandAll: Opens every team and package in the list.
FlightPicker/CollapseAll: Closes every team and package in the list.
FlightPicker/TargetList: ATO Target List: what each package of your side is tasked against, with its flights. Press a package there to find it in the list; press this again to go back.
FlightPicker/Files: Back to the list of saves.
FlightPicker/Retry: Reads the save from the PC again.
FlightPicker/Plan: Plans the flight and seat you picked: every Planner page takes its route, targets and briefing. It may ask WDP's Precision STPT question first.
FlightPicker/Cancel: Closes the window; the Planner keeps planning what it planned before.
FlightPicker/Seat/Lead: Your seat: #1, the flight lead. The DataCard, the loadout and your own target follow the seat.
FlightPicker/Seat/Wing: Your seat: #2, the lead's wingman. Greyed when the flight has fewer aircraft.
FlightPicker/Seat/Element lead: Your seat: #3, leading the second element. Greyed when the flight has fewer aircraft.
FlightPicker/Seat/Element wing: Your seat: #4, the element lead's wingman. Greyed when the flight has fewer aircraft.

Shell/PagePicker/DATACARD: DataCard: your flight's kneeboard card (steerpoints, times, fuel, frequencies, airfields, loadout). Upd Kneeboard puts it in the cockpit.

Shell/Notice/0: Something to know about what you are planning (the theater, where the weather comes from). Press to read it in full.
Shell/More/Notice/0: Something to know about what you are planning (the theater, where the weather comes from). Press to read it in full.

Shell/NotLinked/Setup: Opens Setup, where this device is linked to BMS Companion on the PC that runs Falcon BMS.
Shell/NotLinked/Guide: The guide's page on planning from a phone, a tablet or a browser. It reads without the link.
OpenMission/Close: Closes the window without opening anything.
OpenMission/BackToBriefing: Plans from BMS's printed briefing and your cartridge again, instead of the save's flight.
OpenMission/NotLinked: The saves are Falcon BMS's files on the PC: link this device to BMS Companion there (Setup) to open them.
FlightPicker/Package: Type a package number, then Find package (or Enter) to open it in the list.
FlightPicker/Targets: Your side's packages, each with what its flights are tasked against. Press one to find it in the list of flights.
FlightPicker/Selected: The flight you picked: callsign, mission, aircraft and base. Plan this flight plans it.
FlightPicker/Source: Where the steerpoints will come from, for each answer to the Precision STPT question: your DTC's precision points, or the save's route.
FlightPicker/Close: Closes the window; the Planner keeps planning what it planned before.
FlightPicker/BackToBriefing: Plans from BMS's printed briefing and your cartridge again, instead of the save's flight.
FlightPicker/Guide: The guide's page on planning from a phone, a tablet or a browser. It reads without the link.
FlightPicker/NotLinked: The save is read on the PC: link this device to BMS Companion there (Setup).
FlightPicker/Note/0: What the PC noticed about this save or flight (another theater, older than the printed briefing, already flown…). Press to read all of it.
FlightPicker/Note/1: What the PC noticed about this save or flight (another theater, older than the printed briefing, already flown…). Press to read all of it.
FlightPicker/Note/2: What the PC noticed about this save or flight (another theater, older than the printed briefing, already flown…). Press to read all of it.

FlightPicker/Note/4: What the PC noticed about this save or flight (another theater, older than the printed briefing, already flown…). Press to read all of it.
FlightPicker/Note/5: What the PC noticed about this save or flight (another theater, older than the printed briefing, already flown…). Press to read all of it.
Print/Close: Closes the window. The pages you chose are kept for next time; nothing is written until Print.
Print/MissionSet: Plans the usual set: the DataCard on the first page free for the Planner, the Coordination Card on the next, every other half as it is (in EZBoards mode, EZBoards keeps its pages).
Print/Browse: Picks a picture file on the PC (a chart, a photo) to print on a half page, stretched to fill it as WDP does.
Print/TestPage: Plans a test page (a grid and a circle) on both halves of the page in the preview, to check how BMS shows a page.
Print/LeaveAll: Leaves every half page as it is: nothing is planned to print.
Print/PutBack: Writes Falcon BMS's own shipped kneeboard page back over the page in the preview, or over all 16. Greyed where BMS ships no copies for this theater.
Print/PutBackPage: Writes BMS's own page back over the page in the preview, both knees.
Print/PutBackAll: Writes BMS's own pages back over all 16 kneeboard pages.
Print/Help: The guide's page on Upd Kneeboard: which pages, EZBoards, and when BMS reads them.
Print/Print: Draws every planned half on this device and writes the page files into Falcon BMS's kneeboard (KoreaObj 7982-7997.dds). BMS shows them the next time you enter the cockpit: print before you COMMIT, with the 3D pilot model on (Alt+C, P). Ctrl+Insert turns the left knee's page, Ctrl+PgUp the right knee's.
Print/Preview: The half page picked in the table, as it will be printed; a half left as it is shows what is on it now.
Print/Results: What the last Print or Put BMS's page back did, file by file, and why a file was not written.
Print/Pic/Preview: The picture as it will fill the half page: stretched to it, as WDP does.
Print/Pic/Prev: The page before: which kneeboard page (1-16) the picture goes on.
Print/Pic/Next: The next page: which kneeboard page (1-16) the picture goes on.
Print/Pic/InsertL: Puts the picture on this page's left-knee half. Print writes it.
Print/Pic/InsertR: Puts the picture on this page's right-knee half. Print writes it.
Print/Pic/Browse: Picks another picture file on the PC.
Print/Pic/Cancel: Back to the pages without the picture; the plan stays as it was.
Print/Kind/leave: Leaves this half as it is: Print does not touch it.
Print/Kind/picture: A picture file on the PC (a chart, a photo), stretched to fill the half page. Opens Browse picture.
Print/Kind/test: A test page, a grid and a circle, to check how BMS shows a page.
Print/Kind/datacard-l: The DataCard's left half, drawn from the DataCard page as it is now.
Print/Kind/datacard-r: The DataCard's right half, drawn from the DataCard page as it is now.
Print/Kind/coordination-l: The Coordination Card's left half, from the Coordination Card page as it is now.
Print/Kind/coordination-r: The Coordination Card's right half, from the Coordination Card page as it is now.
Print/Kind/briefing: The Briefing page: mission, situation, threats, objectives and your notes.
Print/Kind/weather: The Briefing page's weather list, with the ATIS.
Print/Kind/targets-l: Target list, left: your flight plan (STPT 1-24) with each point's time, altitude and position, then the target points and STPT 81-99.
Print/Kind/targets-r: Target list, right: the threats with their rings, the four lines and the weapon target points, from the DTC page (unsaved edits included).
Print/Kind/routemap: A map of your route: the flight plan, the targets, the threat rings, the lines and the DataCard's three airfields.
Print/Kind/attack: The attack profile of the attack page on show (Pop-up, HADB or TOSS), else the one the DataCard picked.
Print/Kind/departure: The ground chart of the DataCard's departure airfield.
Print/Kind/arrival: The ground chart of the DataCard's arrival airfield.
Print/Kind/alternate: The ground chart of the DataCard's alternate airfield.

AtoTargets/Retry: Reads the save from the PC again.
AtoTargets/File: The save the targets are read from, and its theater. It is read again each time the page is shown.
AtoTargets/Clock: The save's campaign clock: a TOT before it has passed, a take-off before it means the flight is airborne.
AtoTargets/KeyPassed: A TOT in red has passed by the save's clock.
AtoTargets/KeyAirborne: A row in steel blue is a flight that has taken off by the save's clock.
AtoTargets/Tab/Units: Targets that are units of the save: battalions, brigades, ships.
AtoTargets/Tab/Objectives: Targets that are objectives: airbases, bridges, factories and the like.
AtoTargets/Units: Targets that are units of the save (battalions, brigades, ships), one row per flight tasked against one.
AtoTargets/Objectives: Targets that are objectives (airbases, bridges, factories…), one row per flight tasked against one.
AtoTargets/Units/List: One row per flight of your side tasked against a unit. Press a row to mark it; for information only.
AtoTargets/Objectives/List: One row per flight of your side tasked against an objective. Press a row to mark it; for information only.
AtoTargets/Bar: Drag to move the list sideways; Nr and TARGET stay in place.
AtoTargets/Units/Sort/Nr: Sorts the list by number (Nr); press again to reverse.
AtoTargets/Units/Sort/TARGET: Sorts the list by the target's name; press again to reverse.
AtoTargets/Units/Sort/TOT: Sorts the list by the time on target; press again to reverse.
AtoTargets/Units/Sort/Lat: Sorts the list by latitude; press again to reverse.
AtoTargets/Units/Sort/Long: Sorts the list by longitude; press again to reverse.
AtoTargets/Units/Sort/Package: Sorts the list by package number; press again to reverse.
AtoTargets/Units/Sort/Flight: Sorts the list by the flight's callsign; press again to reverse.
AtoTargets/Units/Sort/Aircraft: Sorts the list by aircraft type; press again to reverse.
AtoTargets/Units/Sort/Type: Sorts the list by the flight's mission type; press again to reverse.
AtoTargets/Units/Sort/Squadron: Sorts the list by squadron; press again to reverse.
AtoTargets/Units/Sort/Airbase: Sorts the list by the flight's base; press again to reverse.
AtoTargets/Units/Sort/TakeOff: Sorts the list by take-off time; press again to reverse.
AtoTargets/Objectives/Sort/Nr: Sorts the list by number (Nr); press again to reverse.
AtoTargets/Objectives/Sort/TARGET: Sorts the list by the target's name; press again to reverse.
AtoTargets/Objectives/Sort/TOT: Sorts the list by the time on target; press again to reverse.
AtoTargets/Objectives/Sort/Lat: Sorts the list by latitude; press again to reverse.
AtoTargets/Objectives/Sort/Long: Sorts the list by longitude; press again to reverse.
AtoTargets/Objectives/Sort/Package: Sorts the list by package number; press again to reverse.
AtoTargets/Objectives/Sort/Flight: Sorts the list by the flight's callsign; press again to reverse.
AtoTargets/Objectives/Sort/Aircraft: Sorts the list by aircraft type; press again to reverse.
AtoTargets/Objectives/Sort/Type: Sorts the list by the flight's mission type; press again to reverse.
AtoTargets/Objectives/Sort/Squadron: Sorts the list by squadron; press again to reverse.
AtoTargets/Objectives/Sort/Airbase: Sorts the list by the flight's base; press again to reverse.
AtoTargets/Objectives/Sort/TakeOff: Sorts the list by take-off time; press again to reverse.
Loadout/Filter/ALL: Shows every store: all this jet carries, or all the station picked takes.
Loadout/Filter/AG: Shows only the air-to-ground stores: bombs, missiles and rockets.
Loadout/Filter/OTHER: Shows fuel tanks, pods and the rest.
Loadout/Filter/ON: Shows only the stores on this aircraft now.
Loadout/Both: Both sides: what you hang, add or take off goes on the matching hardpoint across the jet too. Off: each station on its own.
Loadout/Copy: Gives the stores of the aircraft picked (Lead, Wingman…) to every aircraft of the flight.
Loadout/Status: What your last tap did, in green, or why it could not be done, in red; else what to do next.
Loadout/Minus/1: Takes one store off station 1 (and off the station across the jet with Both sides on, when it carries the same).
Loadout/Plus/1: Puts one more store on station 1, up to what its rack takes (and across the jet with Both sides on).
Loadout/Clear/1: Empties station 1 (and the station across the jet with Both sides on, when it carries the same store).
